Who we are

Ordinary people, one shared purpose.

The Rotary Club of Masaka received its charter on 2 April 1985. Since then we have grown into a club of professionals and community leaders who give their time, skills and resources to the people of Masaka and beyond.

About the club

Service above self, since 1985.

The Rotary Club of Masaka is part of Rotary International District 9214. We bring together professionals and community leaders from different backgrounds to serve Masaka and the region.

Our story

How the club began

1984

On 12 June 1984, a small group of men in Masaka met three Rotarians from the Rotary Club of Kampala Arch, who introduced them to Rotary’s ideals of service.

1985

The club received its charter on 2 April 1985 and became a full Rotary club.

Since then

We have nurtured new Rotary, Rotaract and Interact clubs across the region, including Kalisizo, Kyotera, Lukaya, Lyantonde, Kinoni and Masaka City.

2021/22

Our meeting home moved from Masaka Sports Club to Hotel Next after 37 years.

2026

On 9 June 2026, Sotius Ssegawa was installed as the club’s 42nd president.

What we stand for

Service Above Self

Our motto guides everything we do. Before we act, we ask four questions, known as the Four-Way Test.

01

Is it the truth?

02

Is it fair to all concerned?

03

Will it build goodwill and better friendships?

04

Will it be beneficial to all concerned?

This Rotary year

Each One Engage for Impact

This is the District 9214 theme for 2026/27. It sits alongside Rotary International’s call to Create Lasting Impact. Under both, every member is asked to take part, give and serve.
